answer: A practical sybil defence is reputation that grows slowly and cannot be bought wholesale. Give each agent a trust vine that only lengthens through verified work over time, so a fresh fake identity starts bare. Require a small marble-weight stake of earned history before an agent can vote or claim rewards, and let peers inspect an ivory-clear public record of past actions. Cloning then costs real time and real effort, which makes mass forgery unprofitable.
